ang:1.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

ang:1.gurmukhi: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
ang:1.translation: Chant And Meditate:

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
ang:1.translation: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
ang:1.translation: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
ang:1.translation: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
ang:1.translation: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
ang:1.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
ang:1.translation: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
ang:1.translation: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
ang:1.translation: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
ang:1.translation: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
ang:1.translation: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

ang:1.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
ang:1.translation: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

ang:263.translation: Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
ang:263.translation: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:263.translation: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God are honorable.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God are approved.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
Those who remember God are not lacking.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
Those who remember God dwell in peace.
Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
Those who remember God generously help others.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God abide in peace.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Remembering God, one never grieves.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
ang:263.translation: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
ang:263.translation: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
ang:263.translation: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
ang:263.translation: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
ang:263.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||
Salok:

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
ang:263.translation: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

ang:263.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
ang:263.translation: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||

ang:3.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||
Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.
Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||
Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.
Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.
Listening-even the blind find the Path.
Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:3.translation: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.
No paper, no pen, no scribe
can record the state of the faithful.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
ang:3.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||
The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
The faithful know about all worlds and realms.
The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:3.translation: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
ang:3.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||
The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.
The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.
The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
ang:3.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||
The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.
The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.
The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
ang:3.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||
The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.
The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.
No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,
the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.
The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;
this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.
One who understands this becomes truthful.
What a great load there is on the bull!
So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
ang:3.translation: What power holds them, and supports their weight?
The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings
were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.
Who knows how to write this account?
Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!
What power! What fascinating beauty!
And what gifts! Who can know their extent?
You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!
Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

ang:3.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
ang:3.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||
Countless meditations, countless loves.
Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.
Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.
Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.

ang:394.translation: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;
I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.
How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
ang:394.translation: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92||
Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
ang:394.translation: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.
Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
ang:394.translation: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:394.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||
Your actions seem so sweet to me.
Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||
The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:394.translation: they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||
She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੯੪॥
ang:394.translation: says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.
My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.
My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.
He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||
It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:394.translation: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||
I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.
He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.
Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.
The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||
I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.
What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?
I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.
My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||
When I saw my Beloved's face before me,
I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.
Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.
The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.
Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.
She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||
Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:394.translation: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||
Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.
She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||
Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grown weary.
They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
ang:394.translation: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||
Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.
The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.

ang:394.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
ang:394.translation: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.
Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||
The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
ang:466.translation: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||
First Mehl:

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
ang:466.translation: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
ang:466.translation: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
ang:466.translation: Pauree:

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
ang:466.translation: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
ang:466.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they become truthful or false.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they lose social status and class.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
ang:466.translation: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
ang:466.translation: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
ang:466.translation: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
ang:466.translation: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
ang:466.translation: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
ang:466.translation: Second Mehl:

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:466.translation: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
ang:466.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
ang:466.translation: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
ang:466.translation: Pauree:

ang:466.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀੲਂੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
ang:466.translation: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
ang:468.translation: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
ang:468.translation: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
ang:468.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
ang:468.translation: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
ang:468.translation: Pauree:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
ang:468.translation: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
ang:468.translation: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
ang:468.translation: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
ang:468.translation: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
ang:468.translation: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
ang:468.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
ang:468.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||
First Mehl:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
ang:468.translation: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
ang:468.translation: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
ang:468.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
ang:468.translation: Pauree:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
ang:468.translation: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
ang:468.translation: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
ang:468.translation: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
ang:468.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
ang:468.translation: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
ang:468.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
ang:468.translation: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
ang:468.translation: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
ang:468.translation: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
ang:468.translation: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||
First Mehl:

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

ang:468.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
ang:468.translation: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.

ang:560.translation: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:560.translation: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||
The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.
Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.
He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||
The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.
The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.
My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:560.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.
My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.
The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||
O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,
through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire. ||4||7||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.
Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:560.translation: by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.
The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||
Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.
It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
ang:560.translation: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
ang:560.translation: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled. ||1||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ang:560.translation: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
ang:560.translation: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
ang:560.translation: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to abide in the mind. ||3||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
ang:560.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੨॥
ang:560.translation: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbed in Him. ||4||9||12||
Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is one bed, and One Lord God.
The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||

ang:560.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
ang:560.translation: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord.

search:0:30:ਹਨਨਵ.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
search:0:30:ਹਨਨਵ.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.
The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: My True God knows all ways and means.
Meeting her Beloved, the obtains eternal peace. ||2||

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: You are mother, father and friend, O Lord and Master; the whole world is Your child, O Lord of the World.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਉ ਰਹਸਿਅੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.
Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1||
Meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace through the Word of the Shabad.

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and the Lord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||

search:0:30:ਮਪਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਪਛ ਸਤ ਸਪਤ ਪਿਤੁ ਪਰੈ ਨਰਕ ਕੁਲ ਸੋਇ ॥

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਘਾਇ ॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਵ ਸੰਤਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pleasures are found. ||1||Pause||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticed and beguiled them all. ||1||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet. ||1||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart. ||2||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained; egotism is obliterated through the Word of the Shabad.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: True Praise, True Devotional Praise, is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||5||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: One who serves the True Guru is always at peace; the True Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord. ||3||

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Serving the True Guru, she finds lasting peace; the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, dwells in her mind.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.

search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
search:1:30:ਸਸਸਸਪ.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

search:1:30:ਹਦਨਵੲ.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:ਹਦਨਵੲ.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

search:1:30:ਹਨਨਵਹਦਨਵੲ.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:ਹਨਨਵਹਦਨਵੲ.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

search:1:30:ਕਕਤਮਮ.translation: Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.

search:1:30:ਕਕਤਮਮ.gurmukhi: ਠਉਰ ਅਡੀਠ ਕੇ ਜੈ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਹਿ ਤੇਜਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਸੀਖਨ ਆਏ ॥੧੭੭॥
search:1:30:ਕਕਤਮਮ.translation: It seems that in order to conquer the invisible place, the mind in the form of particles hath come to learn about swiftness from the hooves.177.,

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Your actions seem so sweet to me.

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.
- their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੯੦॥੧੫੯॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: if they enshrine the Lord's Feet within their minds. ||4||90||159||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬਨ ਬੀਚ ਬਿਰਾਜਤ ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਜੋਊ ਪਿਖਵੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਭੈ ॥੪੭੦॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Seeing whom, the deer of the forest come running and whose mind ever wants to see Krishna, the same Krishna is there in the forest and whosoever sees him, his mind becomes covetous for seeing him.470.

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਪੈ ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਰਸ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਨੈਨਨ ਭਉਹ ਤਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਤ ਲੈਸੇ ॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: It appears that Krishna as god of love is discharging the arrows of passionate love by stretching his eyebrows

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੌਨ ਕੋ ਮੁਖ ਲੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥੭॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: On what analogy should he be called Murar? 3.

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹੋ ਅਰਿ ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਪਕ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਲਹਿ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥੧੩੧੦॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Uttering the word “Dev” from your mouth, add the word “ardan” at the end, after that speak the word “Pati” three times, then adding the word “ari”, know the names of Tupak in your mind.1310.

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: - his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||6||8||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||

search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.gurmukhi: ਹੋ ਜਹਾ ਹੁਤੋ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਥ ਤਹੀ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਲਿਯੋ ॥੪॥
ਜਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਬਿਧ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
search:1:30:ਤਕਮਲ.translation: Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.

search:1:30:ਦਸਬਮੲਸਕਤਕਨਟ.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸਿਵਾ ਬਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਟਰੋ ॥
search:1:30:ਦਸਬਮੲਸਕਤਕਨਟ.translation: O Goddess, grant me this that I may not hesitate from performing good actions.

search:1:30:ਦਦਸਰਭਜਸਤਨਹ.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
search:1:30:ਦਦਸਰਭਜਸਤਨਹ.translation: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.

search:1:30:ਪਕਸਸਤੳ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
search:1:30:ਪਕਸਸਤੳ.translation: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.
Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace.
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, peace is obtained; Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door. ||2||7||11||

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, Nanak has found peace. From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the friend of His devotees. ||2||2||21||

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
search:4:20:ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

search:4:20:ਤੇਰਾ ਮੀਠਾ.translation: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,
Your actions seem so sweet to me.
